answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the quartz of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. A harbor of per-task receipts records who did what, and the hollow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
